Use-case / requirements (as captured):

- Latency: sub-200ms token turn for agent assist in typical cases, tail SLA 500ms; want steady throughput during billing spikes (x10 baseline for 48-72h).
- Cost sensitivity: willing to commit reserved capacity for predictable spend but needs unit economics for peak windows.
- Models: prefer on-prem/VPC variants of open LLMs or Redwood-verified quantized variants; quality guardrails required (prompt-level allowlists/deny lists).

- Security: SSO/SAML for console, customer-managed KMS, immutable audit logs retained 7 years, exportable for e-discovery, SOC2+/ISO27001 required, PCI attestation for payment flows and HIPAA BAAs for PHI.

POC scope (agreed):
- 1-week VPC POC: agent assist on 2 agent flows (payments + prescription refills), ticket summarization on 500 historical tickets, tool-calling integration to Genesys sandbox.
